data.body_html:
October 2036 is one of the best months for a Marbella boat rental. The shoulder season brings warm sea temperatures of 22°C, calm winds, and fewer crowds — all at lower rates than summer. Whether you want a 2-hour sunset cruise or an 8-hour coastal exploration, our fleet departs daily from Puerto Banús. Here’s what you need to know about the weather, the boats, and how to book.

October 2036 Weather: What to Expect

Marbella enjoys a Mediterranean climate, and October stays pleasant. Daytime highs reach 26°C, dropping to 18°C at night. Sea temperatures hover around 22°C — warm enough for swimming. You’ll get about 9 hours of sunshine per day, with only 3–4 rainy days on average. Wind speeds are light (5–15 knots), so the sea stays calm. This is ideal for smooth cruising along the Costa del Sol.

Best Boats for October Charter

Our fleet suits every group size. For small groups (up to 5), the Dubhe (8m) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m) are nimble and affordable. For up to 11 guests, the Azimut 39 (12.5m) or Astondoa 40 (12.5m) offer comfort and style — both Tier A boats at €749/2h or €2,299/8h. For larger parties, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) includes a free jet ski from €4,719 for 4 hours. All depart from Puerto Banús.

Pricing and Inclusions

October rates are lower than July and August. Tier A boats start at €749 for 2 hours (skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, IVA included). The Mangusta 80 (white or grey) requires a minimum 4-hour booking at €4,719, with a jet ski included. Other boats — like the Ferretti 94, Canados 86, or Maiora 26m — are priced on request via WhatsApp. Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and 21% Spanish VAT.

Where to Cruise in October

Calm seas open up many routes. Head west past the Golden Mile to Cabopino for a beach lunch, or east to Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés for secluded coves. Longer trips to Estepona or Sotogrande are comfortable. For sunset views, cruise the coast with La Concha mountain as your backdrop. All boats depart from Puerto Banús, the heart of Marbella’s luxury marina.

Why Book in Advance

October is shoulder season, but weekends can still fill up. Book at least 1–2 weeks ahead to secure your preferred boat and time slot. We recommend the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) for panoramic views, or the Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax) for a sporty ride. Use our WhatsApp line for quick pricing on any boat not listed in Tier A or Tier B.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the weather like in Marbella in October 2036?

October in Marbella is mild and sunny, with daytime highs around 26°C and lows near 18°C. Sea temperatures stay warm at 22°C. Expect about 9 hours of sunshine daily and only 3–4 rainy days. Winds are typically light, making it a great month for boat charters.

Can I swim and do water sports in October?

Yes. The sea temperature of 22°C is comfortable for swimming, snorkelling, and jet skiing. Our Mangusta 80 charter includes a free jet ski, and all boats have easy swim platform access.

Are boat rental rates cheaper in October?

October is shoulder season, so rates are lower than peak summer. Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) start at €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for a full 8-hour day, with all inclusions. Other boats are priced on request via WhatsApp.

Which boats are available for charter in October?

Our full fleet is available, from the 12.5m Astondoa 40 (9 pax) to the 29m Ferretti 94 (12 pax). All depart from Puerto Banús. Smaller options like the Dubhe (5 pax) or Speedboat (6 pax) are ideal for smaller groups.

Do I need to book in advance for October?

While October is less busy, we recommend booking at least 1–2 weeks ahead to secure your preferred boat and date. Popular vessels like the Mangusta 80 and Azimut 58 Flybridge can still fill up on weekends.

What destinations can I visit from Puerto Banús in October?

Popular routes include Marbella’s Golden Mile, Cabopino, Cala del Faro, Cala Cortés, Estepona, and Sotogrande. Calm seas make longer trips to Gibraltar or the Costa del Sol coastline comfortable.

What is included in the charter price?

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden costs.

What should I bring for an October boat trip?

Bring a light jacket or sweater for the evening, sunscreen, sunglasses, a hat, and swimwear. The sun is still strong, and sea breezes can feel cooler after sunset.

Ready to book your Marbella boat rental for October 2036? Choose your boat, send us a WhatsApp, and enjoy the shoulder season at its best.
